auth_otp_sent: 验证码已发送到您的手机。
auth_phone_desc: 请输入您的手机号码。如果您还没有账号，我们会自动帮您创建一个。
docs_found_title: 您的证件已经保存好啦
docs_found_hint: 我们找到了您之前上传的机票、护照和签证。您可以继续用这些，或者换掉不对的或已经改了的。
logout_confirm: 要退出吗？您的行程会保留。再次登录即可查看。
quick_hint: 如果已经办好了，我们就会把它从您的清单中删除。您可以随时在这里更改您的答案。
dup_body: 这些文件已经在您的一个行程中了。要不打开那个行程，这样所有东西都在一个地方？
help_intro: 您的文件都准备好了。如果您在任何时候需要帮助，请点击屏幕底部的蓝色“帮助”按钮。如果您迷路了，请点击红色的“我迷路了”按钮。
bag_not_on_ticket: 您的机票上没有打印：这是通常的限制。请和航空公司确认一下。
help_hint_short: 需要帮忙吗？请点击屏幕底部的蓝色“帮助”按钮，或者红色的“我迷路了”按钮。点击这里可以听到这段话。
boarding_estimated: 预计：起飞前45分钟左右。请您根据登机牌上的时间，点击保存。
wt_hint: 一分钟带您了解这个软件怎么用，会用您的行程来演示。
wt_lang_say: 首先，请选择您的语言。所有屏幕显示和语音都会随之改变。
wt_upload_say: 请为每位乘机人拍下机票、护照和签证的照片。应用会自动读取这些信息。
wt_check_say: 应用会检查姓名、日期和护照有效期，并告诉您是否有需要修改的地方。
wt_contacts_say: 添加家人的电话号码，这样在您需要帮助时，可以一键呼叫他们。
wt_checklist_say: 乘机前您的待办事项清单。完成一项就勾选一项。
wt_day_say: 在机场，请一步一步跟着指示走。需要时，可以把英文句子给工作人员看。
wt_help_say: 点击“帮助”，您可以通过语音或文字提问，向工作人员展示句子，或者了解您的登机牌。
wt_lost_say: 点击“我迷路了”，可以向工作人员展示一张大卡片，上面有您的航班、登机口和家人电话号码。
wt_end_say: 这就是“我的首次飞行”应用。祝您旅途平安！
auth_voice: 要登录，请您输入带国家区号的电话号码，然后点击 {send}。我们会通过短信给您发送一个验证码。或者，您也可以点击 {google}。
auth_voice_otp: 我们已经通过短信给您的手机发送了一个验证码。请您输入验证码，然后点击 {verify}。
fb_hint: 您的意见能帮助我们把这个软件做得更好，让更多第一次坐飞机的人受益。
fb_helped: 哪个地方对您帮助最大？
fb_comment: 还有其他想说的吗？(可不填)
fb_comment_ph: 哪些地方您觉得容易？哪些地方觉得难？
fb_thanks: 谢谢您！您的意见已保存。
lang_voice_hint: 点一下麦克风，然后说出您想用的语言。
lang_voice_fail: 抱歉，我没听清您说的语言。请再试一次，或者在下面选择您的语言。
lang_mic_denied: 麦克风未授权。请在下面选择您的语言。
lang_intro: 这些语言都可以选：{list}。请点一下您想用的语言，或者点麦克风说出来。
flight_started: 您的第一次飞行已经开始。
story_sub: 一个关于您第一次飞行的短故事，用您的语言大声讲出来。想象一下就是您。
story_end: MyFirstFlightAI 就是这样照顾您的，从家里到抵达目的地。
story_1: 想象您的第一次飞行。它从家里开始。
story_2: 拍下您的机票、护照和签证的照片。应用程序会为您读取它们。
story_3: 和家人一起旅行？添加每个人，以及他们自己的证件。
story_4: 在您到达机场前几天，应用程序会在家里检查每个人的姓名、护照和签证。
story_5: 它会告诉您在飞行前的每一天该做什么，并大声读出每一步。
story_7: 在机场，它会显示接下来去哪里，以及在每个柜台该说什么。
story_8: 如果您感到迷路，一个红色按钮会向任何工作人员显示您的详细信息。
story_10: 您的家人正在等您。欢迎。
err_auth_verify: 我们暂时无法发送验证码到这个号码。请检查号码是否正确，或者用谷歌账号继续。
trip_delete_body: 这会把这个旅程、它的文件、清单和联系人从应用里删除。删除了就不能恢复了哦。
trip_finish_hint: 结束旅程后，它会移到“过去的旅程”里。您随时都可以再打开看。
trip_finished_toast: 旅程已结束。您可以在“过去的旅程”里找到它。
trip_reopen: 还没结束吗？把它移回来
land_title: 您的第一次飞行，用您自己的语言。
land_sub: MyFirstFlightAI 会帮您看机票、护照和签证，在家就能检查好，然后一步步地、大声地告诉您机场里该怎么走。
land_langs_d: 选择您的语言。每个屏幕、每个步骤和每个回答都会用您的语言显示，还可以大声读出来。
land_s1_d: 给您的机票、护照和签证拍张照片。这个应用会帮您读取信息。
land_s2_d: 在去机场前几天，我们会帮您检查姓名、护照和签证，这样就能早点发现问题。
land_s3_d: 告诉您飞行前三天、前一天和飞行当天要做些什么。
land_s4_d: 告诉您接下来去哪里，工作人员会问什么，以及用英语和您的语言怎么说。
land_s5_d: 感觉迷路了？一个红色按钮就能向任何工作人员显示您的姓名、航班和家人的电话号码。
land_family: 为您的父母设置这个应用吗？
land_family_d: 在他们的手机上登录，添加他们的行程，这个应用就会用他们的语言一步步引导他们。
moment_board: 请登上您的 {flight} 航班。请在登机口出示您的登机牌。
lang_choose_below: 请从下面的语言中选择您的语言：{list}。
err_phone_digits: 请您检查一下电话号码。印度的手机号码是10位数，开头是6、7、8或者9，比如98765 43210。如果是其他国家的号码，请在前面加上“+”和国家代码。
fb_speak_hint: 或者点击麦克风说出来。您说的话会显示在这里。
err_check_details: 有些信息不对。请您再检查一下，然后重新尝试。
err_phone_country: 这个不是有效的{country}电话号码。
quick_have_hint: 如果您选“是的”，我们就会把“托运行李”这项加到您飞机起飞那天的清单里。
choose_lang_dropdown: 请在下拉菜单中选择您的首选语言

__source.bag_not_on_ticket: Not printed on your ticket: this is the usual limit. Please confirm with the airline.
__source.help_hint_short: Need help? Use the blue Help button or the red I'm Lost button at the bottom of the screen. Tap here to hear this.
__source.boarding_estimated: Estimated: about 45 minutes before departure. Change it to the time on your boarding pass and tap Save.
__source.wt_hint: A 1-minute tour of how this app works, shown with your own trip.
__source.wt_lang_say: First, pick your language. Every screen and every voice switches to it.
__source.wt_upload_say: Add each traveller with a photo of the ticket, passport and visa. The app reads them for you.
__source.wt_check_say: The app checks names, dates and passport validity, and tells you if anything needs fixing.
__source.wt_contacts_say: Add family numbers, so you can call them with one tap if you need help.
__source.wt_checklist_say: Your to-do list before the flight. Tick each task when it is done.
__source.wt_day_say: At the airport, follow one step at a time. Show the English sentence to staff when you need to.
__source.wt_help_say: Tap Help to ask any question by voice or text, show a sentence to staff, or understand your boarding pass.
__source.wt_lost_say: Tap I'm Lost to show staff a big card with your flight, gate and family numbers.
__source.wt_end_say: That is MyFirstFlightAI. Have a safe trip!
__source.auth_voice: To sign in, type your phone number with the country code, then tap {send}. We will send you a code by SMS. Or tap {google}.
__source.auth_voice_otp: We sent a code to your phone by SMS. Type the code, then tap {verify}.
__source.fb_title: How was your trip with MyFirstFlightAI?
__source.fb_hint: Your answer helps us make the app better for other first-time flyers.
__source.fb_comment_ph: What was easy? What was hard?
__source.fb_thanks: Thank you! Your feedback is saved.
__source.lang_voice_hint: Tap the mic and say your language.
__source.lang_voice_fail: Sorry, I could not hear a language. Please try again, or tap your language below.
__source.lang_mic_denied: Microphone not allowed. Please tap your language below.
__source.lang_intro: These languages are available: {list}. Tap your language below, or tap the mic and say it.
__source.story_sub: A short story of your first flight, told aloud in your language. Imagine it is you.
__source.story_end: That is how MyFirstFlightAI looks after you, from home to arrival.
__source.story_1: Imagine your first flight. It begins at home.
__source.story_2: Take a photo of your ticket, your passport and your visa. The app reads them for you.
__source.story_3: Travelling with family? Add each person, with their own papers.
__source.story_4: The app checks every name, passport and visa, at home, days before you reach the airport.
__source.story_5: It tells you what to do on each day before the flight, and reads every step aloud.
__source.story_6: On the day, you set off for the airport.
__source.story_7: At the airport, it shows where to go next, and what to say at every counter.
__source.story_8: If you ever feel lost, one red button shows your details to any staff member.
__source.err_auth_verify: We could not send a code to this number right now. Please check the number, or continue with Google.

__source.trip_finish_hint: Finishing moves this trip to Past trips. You can still open it any time.
__source.trip_finished_toast: Trip finished. You will find it under Past trips.
__source.land_title: Your first flight, in your own language.
__source.land_sub: MyFirstFlightAI reads your ticket, passport and visa, checks them at home, and walks you through the airport step by step, out loud.
__source.land_langs_d: Choose yours. Every screen, every step and every answer is in your language, and can be read aloud.
__source.land_s1_d: Take a photo of your ticket, passport and visa. The app reads them for you.
__source.land_s2_d: Names, passport and visa are checked days before the airport, so problems are found early.
__source.land_s3_d: What to do three days before, one day before, and on the day you fly.
__source.land_s4_t: Step by step at the airport
__source.land_s4_d: Where to go next, what staff will ask, and what to say, in English and in your language.
__source.land_s5_d: Feel lost? One red button shows your name, flight and family's number to any staff member.
__source.land_family: Setting it up for your parents?
__source.land_family_d: Sign in on their phone, add their trip, and the app talks them through the rest in their own language.

__source.moment_arrive_any: Your family is waiting for you.
